Unitree Controller:
  -h [ --help ]                       produce help message
  -v [ --version ]                    show version
  --log                               record log file
  -n [ --network ] arg                dds network interface
  --check-lowcmd                      report lowcmd channel status without 
                                      publishing
  --lowcmd-monitor-seconds arg        count rt/lowcmd samples for this many 
                                      seconds without publishing
  --service-list                      list Go2 robot services without 
                                      publishing LowCmd
  --release-motion                    release the active motion service and 
                                      exit
  --stairs-policy arg                 override the Go2 stairs policy directory
  --stairs-trace arg                  record Go2 stairs policy and joint 
                                      tracking data as CSV
  --robot-print                       read LowState and run policy inference 
                                      without publishing LowCmd
  --robot-print-steps arg (=100)      number of 50 Hz policy steps for 
                                      --robot-print
  --stairs-speed arg                  override the fixed forward speed command 
                                      used by stairs policy
  --stairs-auto-lie-seconds arg       automatically transition Stairs to 
                                      LieDown after this many seconds
  --stairs-auto-zero-seconds arg      set the stairs forward velocity command 
                                      to zero after this many seconds
  --stairs-safety-disable             disable Go2 stairs realtime safety stop
  --stairs-safety-q-error arg         safety stop threshold for max joint 
                                      tracking error in radians
  --stairs-safety-dq arg              safety stop threshold for max absolute 
                                      joint velocity in rad/s
  --stairs-safety-raw-action arg      safety stop threshold for max absolute 
                                      raw policy action
  --stairs-safety-kp arg              safety stop threshold for adaptive kp 
                                      saturation
  --stairs-safety-kp-frames arg       number of consecutive policy frames above
                                      kp threshold before stopping
  --stairs-safety-orientation-rad arg safety stop threshold for base tilt angle
                                      in radians
